f.title: Definition: safety management information (安全管理情報)
f.statement: Definition that sets the scope of what must be collected and reviewed (not a stand-alone duty): safety management information means information on the quality, efficacy and safety of drugs, quasi-drugs, cosmetics, medical devices or regenerative medicine products ("drugs etc.") and any other information necessary for their proper use.
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1).

rows.actor: All MAHs (in applying the collection and review duties of Articles 7 and 8)
rows.quote: この省令で「安全管理情報」とは、医薬品、医薬部外品、化粧品、医療機器又は再生医療等製品（以下「医薬品等」という。）の品質、有効性及び安全性に関する事項その他医薬品等の適正な使用のために必要な情報をいう。
rows.review_note: Review: binding definition kept as Mandatory (GUIDE: definitions that set what must be handled). No modal verb (〜をいう), so held below 90. Translation check: independent re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In this Ordinance, "safety management information" means information on the quality, efficacy and safety of drugs, quasi-drugs, cosmetics, medical devices or regenerative medicine products ("drugs etc.") and other information necessary for the proper use of drugs etc.

f.title: Definition: Type 1 MAH (prescription drugs, highly controlled devices, regenerative medicine products)
f.statement: Definition that decides which chapter applies: a Type 1 MAH is the MAH of prescription drugs (drugs designated by the Minister under Article 49(1) of the Act), highly controlled medical devices or regenerative medicine products. Type 1 MAHs must meet all of Chapter 2 (Articles 3-12).
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1).

rows.quote_en: In this Ordinance, "Type 1 MAH" means the MAH of drugs designated by the Minister of Health, Labour and Welfare under Article 49(1) of the Act ("prescription drugs"), highly controlled medical devices or regenerative medicine products.

f.title: Definition: Type 2 MAH (non-prescription drugs, controlled devices, in vitro diagnostics)
f.statement: A Type 2 MAH is the MAH of drugs other than prescription drugs, controlled medical devices or in vitro diagnostics. Type 2 MAHs follow Chapter 3 (Article 13 and the Chapter 2 articles applied by Article 14).
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1).

rows.review_note: Review: classification definition, Mandatory. No modal verb, so below 90. Translation check: re-translation agrees.
rows.quote_en: In this Ordinance, "Type 2 MAH" means the MAH of drugs other than prescription drugs, controlled medical devices or in vitro diagnostics.

f.title: Definition: Type 3 MAH (quasi-drugs, cosmetics, general medical devices)
f.statement: A Type 3 MAH is the MAH of quasi-drugs, cosmetics or general medical devices. Type 3 MAHs follow Chapter 4 (the articles applied by Article 15).
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1).

rows.actor: MAHs (classification for applying this Ordinance)

f.statement: A Type 1 MAH must have the GMCO make the safety management supervisor work in close cooperation with the quality assurance manager etc. (GQP quality assurance manager or, for devices and IVDs, the domestic quality operations manager under the QMS Ordinance) and other managers responsible for marketing prescription drugs, highly controlled medical devices or regenerative medicine products.

rows.quote:
第一種製造販売業者は、次の各号に掲げる業務を法第十七条第二項に規定する医薬品等総括製造販売責任者、法第二十三条の二の十四第二項に規定する医療機器等総括製造販売責任者又は法第二十三条の三十四第二項に規定する再生医療等製品総括製造販売責任者（以下「総括製造販売責任者」と総称する。）に行わせなければならない。

rows.quote_en:
A Type 1 MAH shall have the following duties performed by the general marketing compliance officer for drugs etc. under Article 17(2) of the Act, the general marketing compliance officer for medical devices etc. under Article 23-2-14(2) of the Act or the general marketing compliance officer for regenerative medicine products under Article 23-34(2) of the Act (collectively "general marketing compliance officer"):

Have the safety management supervisor in item 1 work in close cooperation with the quality assurance manager etc. (the quality assurance manager under Article 4(3) (including where applied mutatis mutandis under Article 21) and Article 17 of the Ministerial Ordinance on Good Quality Practice for Drugs, Quasi-drugs, Cosmetics and Regenerative Medicine Products (MHLW Ordinance No. 136 of 2004) and the domestic quality operations manager under Article 72(1) (including where applied mutatis mutandis under Article 72-3(3)) of the Ministerial Ordinance on Standards for Manufacturing Control and Quality Control for Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostics (MHLW Ordinance No. 169 of 2004); the same applies below) and other managers responsible for activities relating to the marketing of prescription drugs, highly controlled medical devices or regenerative medicine products.

f.title: Have the GMCO ensure close cooperation with the PMS manager when carrying out risk management
f.statement: Where the Type 1 MAH carries out drug risk management or medical device etc. risk management ("drug etc. risk management"), it must have the GMCO ensure close mutual cooperation with the post-marketing surveillance manager (GPSP Ordinances for drugs or devices, Article 4(1)) so that the risk management is carried out properly.
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1). Chapter 2 duty of Type 1 MAHs; applied mutatis mutandis to Type 2 MAHs (Article 14) and Type 3 MAHs (Article 15), with the readings those articles set.
f.exceptions: Only where the MAH carries out drug etc. risk management.

rows.actor: Type 1 MAH (第一種製造販売業者), through the general marketing compliance officer (総括製造販売責任者); also Type 2 and Type 3 MAHs by Articles 14-15
rows.quote: 四 　 第一種製造販売業者が医薬品リスク管理又は医療機器等リスク管理（以下「医薬品等リスク管理」という。）を行う場合にあっては、当該医薬品等リスク管理が適切に行われるよう、製造販売後調査等管理責任者（医薬品の製造販売後の調査及び試験の実施の基準に関する省令（平成十六年厚生労働省令第百七十一号）第四条第一項又は医療機器の製造販売後の調査及び試験の実施の基準に関する省令（平成十七年厚生労働省令第三十八号）第四条第一項に規定する製造販売後調査等管理責任者をいう。以下同じ。）との相互の密接な連携を図ること。

Where the Type 1 MAH carries out drug risk management or medical device etc. risk management ("drug etc. risk management"), ensure close mutual cooperation with the post-marketing surveillance manager (the post-marketing surveillance manager under Article 4(1) of the Ministerial Ordinance on Good Post-marketing Study Practice for Drugs (MHLW Ordinance No. 171 of 2004) or Article 4(1) of the Ministerial Ordinance on Good Post-marketing Study Practice for Medical Devices (MHLW Ordinance No. 38 of 2005); the same applies below) so that the drug etc. risk management is carried out properly.

f.title: Establish an independent safety management department under the GMCO
f.statement: A Type 1 MAH must establish a department in charge of overall management of safety assurance activities (safety management department) that (1) is under the supervision of the GMCO, (2) has sufficient personnel able to carry out safety assurance activities properly and smoothly (other than activities delegated under Article 4(4)), and (3) is independent of the sales department and any other department that might hinder those activities.
f.clause: Article 4(1) (Organisation and personnel for safety assurance activities)
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1). Type 1 MAHs only (Chapter 2). Type 2 and Type 3 MAHs have their own organisation rules in Article 13 (Type 3 via Article 15).

rows.actor: Type 1 MAH (第一種製造販売業者)
rows.quote:
第一種製造販売業者は、次に掲げる要件を満たす安全確保業務の統括に係る部門（以下この章において「安全管理統括部門」という。）を置かなければならない。
一 　 総括製造販売責任者の監督下にあること。
二 　 安全確保業務（第四項の規定により安全管理責任者以外の者に行わせる業務を除く。）を適正かつ円滑に遂行しうる能力を有する人員を十分に有すること。
三 　 医薬品等の販売に係る部門その他安全確保業務の適正かつ円滑な遂行に支障を及ぼすおそれのある部門から独立していること。
rows.location: Article 4(1) (Organisation and personnel for safety assurance activities)
rows.review_note: Review: one row for the three cumulative requirements. Translation check: re-translation agrees (置かなければならない = shall establish). Role mapping: 総括製造販売責任者 (GMCO) mapped to governance-3 and 安全管理責任者 (safety management supervisor) to governance-1 as the nearest operating-model roles; they are Japanese statutory posts, not identical to those roles.
rows.quote_en:
A Type 1 MAH shall establish a department in charge of the overall management of safety assurance activities ("safety management department" in this Chapter) that meets the following requirements:
1. It is under the supervision of the general marketing compliance officer.
2. It has sufficient personnel with the ability to carry out safety assurance activities (excluding activities performed by persons other than the safety management supervisor under paragraph 4) properly and smoothly.
3. It is independent of the department in charge of sales of drugs etc. and of any other department that might hinder the proper and smooth performance of safety assurance activities.

f.title: Appoint a safety management supervisor with 3+ years' experience, independent of sales
f.statement: A Type 1 MAH must appoint a safety management supervisor who (1) heads the safety management department, (2) has engaged in safety assurance or similar activities for three years or more, (3) is able to carry out safety assurance activities properly and smoothly, and (4) does not belong to the sales department and otherwise poses no risk of hindering those activities.
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1). Type 1 MAHs only (Chapter 2). Type 2 and Type 3 MAHs have their own organisation rules in Article 13 (Type 3 via Article 15).
f.exceptions: Transitional (Supplementary provisions, Ordinance No. 87 of 2014, Article 9): for Type 1 MAHs marketing only programme highly controlled medical devices, until 24 November 2020 a person who completed the special programme medical device course was deemed to meet item 2. That period has ended.

rows.actor: Type 1 MAH (第一種製造販売業者)
rows.quote:
第一種製造販売業者は、次に掲げる要件を満たす安全確保業務の責任者（以下この章において「安全管理責任者」という。）を置かなければならない。
一 　 安全管理統括部門の責任者であること。
二 　 安全確保業務その他これに類する業務に三年以上従事した者であること。
三 　 安全確保業務を適正かつ円滑に遂行しうる能力を有する者であること。
四 　 医薬品等の販売に係る部門に属する者でないことその他安全確保業務の適正かつ円滑な遂行に支障を及ぼすおそれがない者であること。
data_elements: years of experience in safety assurance activities
rows.review_note: Review: 三年以上 = three years or more. The expired transitional deeming rule is noted under exceptions only. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Role mapping: 総括製造販売責任者 (GMCO) mapped to governance-3 and 安全管理責任者 (safety management supervisor) to governance-1 as the nearest operating-model roles; they are Japanese statutory posts, not identical to those roles.
rows.quote_en:
A Type 1 MAH shall appoint a person responsible for safety assurance activities ("safety management supervisor" in this Chapter) who meets the following requirements:
1. Is the head of the safety management department.
2. Has engaged in safety assurance activities or similar activities for three years or more.
3. Has the ability to carry out safety assurance activities properly and smoothly.
4. Does not belong to the department in charge of sales of drugs etc., and is otherwise a person who poses no risk of hindering the proper and smooth performance of safety assurance activities.

f.title: Have the safety management supervisor perform safety assurance activities
f.statement: Except where activities are delegated under Article 4(4), a Type 1 MAH must have the safety management supervisor perform the safety assurance activities.
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1). Type 1 MAHs only (Chapter 2). Type 2 and Type 3 MAHs have their own organisation rules in Article 13 (Type 3 via Article 15).
f.exceptions: Activities delegated to a safety management implementation manager under Article 4(4).

rows.actor: Type 1 MAH (第一種製造販売業者)
rows.quote: 第一種製造販売業者は、次項に規定する場合を除き、安全管理責任者に安全確保業務を行わせなければならない。
rows.review_note: Translation check: re-translation agrees. Role mapping: 総括製造販売責任者 (GMCO) mapped to governance-3 and 安全管理責任者 (safety management supervisor) to governance-1 as the nearest operating-model roles; they are Japanese statutory posts, not identical to those roles.
rows.quote_en: Except in the case provided in the next paragraph, a Type 1 MAH shall have the safety management supervisor perform the safety assurance activities.

f.title: Appoint a safety management implementation manager when delegating safety assurance activities
f.statement: Where a Type 1 MAH has all or part of the safety assurance activities listed in Article 97, 114-59 or 137-59 of the Enforcement Regulations performed by someone other than the safety management supervisor, it must appoint a person responsible for those activities who is able to carry them out properly and smoothly (safety management implementation manager).
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1). Type 1 MAHs only (Chapter 2). Type 2 and Type 3 MAHs have their own organisation rules in Article 13 (Type 3 via Article 15).
f.exceptions: Only where activities are delegated to persons other than the safety management supervisor.
f.processes: Safety governance; Partner & vendor oversight; Local PV interfaces

rows.actor: Type 1 MAH (第一種製造販売業者)
rows.quote: 第一種製造販売業者は、安全確保業務であって医薬品、医療機器等の品質、有効性及び安全性の確保等に関する法律施行規則（昭和三十六年厚生省令第一号。以下「規則」という。）第九十七条各号、第百十四条の五十九各号又は第百三十七条の五十九各号に掲げるものの全部又は一部を安全管理責任者以外の者に行わせる場合にあっては、当該業務を適正かつ円滑に遂行しうる能力を有する当該業務の実施に係る責任者（以下「安全管理実施責任者」という。）を置かなければならない。
rows.review_note: Review: Regulations Art 97 etc. list the activities that may be entrusted (not reproduced here). Translation check: re-translation agrees. Role mapping: 総括製造販売責任者 (GMCO) mapped to governance-3 and 安全管理責任者 (safety management supervisor) to governance-1 as the nearest operating-model roles; they are Japanese statutory posts, not identical to those roles.
rows.quote_en: Where a Type 1 MAH has all or part of the safety assurance activities listed in the items of Article 97, Article 114-59 or Article 137-59 of the Enforcement Regulations of the Act on Securing Quality, Efficacy and Safety of Products Including Pharmaceuticals and Medical Devices (MHW Ordinance No. 1 of 1961; "the Regulations") performed by a person other than the safety management supervisor, it shall appoint a person responsible for carrying out those activities who has the ability to perform them properly and smoothly ("safety management implementation manager").

f.title: Prepare GVP procedures covering the 13 listed procedures
f.statement: To carry out post-marketing safety management properly and smoothly, a Type 1 MAH must prepare post-marketing safety management procedures covering: collection of safety management information; review and planning of safety assurance measures; implementation of measures; reporting from the safety management supervisor to the GMCO; reporting from the safety management implementation manager to the safety management supervisor; drug etc. risk management (incl. EPPV under an RMP) where carried out; EPPV under Article 10-2 where carried out; self-inspection; education and training; record retention; cooperation with the QA manager etc.; cooperation with the PMS manager where risk management is carried out; and other necessary procedures.
f.applicability: Japan; GVP Ordinance (MHLW Ministerial Ordinance No. 135 of 2004), Japanese original from e-Gov, consolidated text as amended up to MHLW Ordinance No. 117 of 2025 (in force 1 May 2026). The text draws no domestic/foreign distinction except the information sources in Article 7(1). Chapter 2 duty of Type 1 MAHs; applied mutatis mutandis to Type 2 MAHs by Article 14; not applied to Type 3 MAHs. Items 5 and 7 are excluded for Type 2 MAHs by Article 14.
f.exceptions: Items 6, 7 and 12 apply only where the MAH carries out drug etc. risk management or EPPV.

rows.actor: Type 1 MAH (第一種製造販売業者); also Type 2 MAHs by Article 14
rows.quote:
第一種製造販売業者は、製造販売後安全管理を適正かつ円滑に行うため、次に掲げる手順を記載した製造販売後安全管理業務手順書を作成しなければならない。
一 　 安全管理情報の収集に関する手順
二 　 安全管理情報の検討及びその結果に基づく安全確保措置の立案に関する手順
三 　 安全確保措置の実施に関する手順

Articles 4, 5, 9-2, 9-3, 10, 10-2, 11 and 12 are not applied to Type 3 MAHs (the range 第六条から第九条まで ends at Article 9 and does not reach the branch articles 9-2 and 9-3).

rows.review_note: Review: mutatis mutandis scope row; quote is the first sentence and the readings of the second sentence are summarised in the statement. The statement's line that Articles 5, 9-2 onward, 11 and 12 are not applied is an inference from the list (第六条から第九条まで read as not including 第九条の二 and 第九条の三, which follow 第九条); held below 90 for a human check. Translation check: re-translation agrees. Independent review: ruling on the range: under Japanese drafting convention 第六条から第九条まで covers Articles 6, 7, 8 and 9 only; branch articles inserted after the end article (第九条の二, 第九条の三) are outside the range (a range that took them in would end 第九条の三まで). The text confirms it: Article 14 (第五条から第十条まで) has to exclude 第九条の二第四項 and 第九条の三第四項 because they fall inside its range, while Article 15 excludes nothing in 9-2/9-3 and sets no readings for them, and reads Article 8(1)(i) 前条及び第十条 as 前条 only. So Type 3 MAHs carry no RMP (9-2), device RMP (9-3) or EPPV (10) duty under this Ordinance; the statement now lists the non-applied articles explicitly. The inference doubt is resolved; held at 88 only because the second-sentence readings are summarised, not quoted (same basis as the Article 14 row at 89).
